Approved demo URLs and GitHub-pinned homepage selection are proposed automatically. New entries, renamed repository links, descriptions, translations, and images require curation. Repository pushes are a review signal, not proof of a visible product change.

Before merging: inspect changed READMEs and live demos, curate src/data/projects.ts and src/data/projects.zh.ts, capture and visually verify affected previews, update progress.md and session-handoff.md, and rerun the full verification gate. Merging to main uses the existing GitHub Pages deployment.
